cases.material:
Today, Technology Secretary Peter Kyle has launched the Artificial Intelligence (AI) Playbook for the UK Government (https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/ai-playbook-for-the-uk-government) to provide departments and public sector organisations with accessible technical guidance on the safe and effective use of AI. 

AI is at the heart of the UK Government's strategy to drive economic growth and enhance public service delivery - it offers significant opportunities to reduce costs and enhance public service delivery across government, as highlighted in the State of Digital Government Review 2025 (https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/state-of-digital-government-review/state-of-digital-government-review#data-and-ai). However, we must remain mindful of both the technology's constraints and potential risks.

## 材料提醒须注意 AI 技术的局限与潜在风险
**主张**：在肯定 AI 机遇的同时，材料指出必须留意该技术的局限（constraints）和潜在风险（potential risks）。

**原文依据**（来源 card-ji4wj4mtypwydt，片段 1 · 原文第 3 行）：
> "However, we must remain mindful of both the technology's constraints and potential risks."

**限制与说明**：片段未列举具体是哪些局限与风险，无法核实其范围与严重程度。

cases.material:
【物理页 6】
NIST AI 100-1   AI RMF 1.0 
Executive Summary 
Artificial intelligence (AI) technologies have significant potential to transform society and
people’s lives – from commerce and health to transportation and cybersecurity to the envi-
ronment and our planet. AI technologies can drive inclusive economic growth and support
scientific advancements that improve the conditions of our world. AI technologies, how-
ever, also pose risks that can negatively impact individuals, groups, organizations, commu-
nities, society, the environment, and the planet. Like risks for other types of technology, AI
risks can emerge in a variety of ways and can be characterized as long- or short-term, high-
or low-probability, systemic or localized, and high- or low-impact.
The AI RMF refers to an   AI system   as an engineered or machine-based system that
can, for a given set of objectives, generate outputs such as predictions, recommenda-
tions, or decisions influencing real or virtual environments. AI systems are designed
to operate with varying levels of autonomy (Adapted from: OECD Recommendation
on AI:2019;   ISO / IEC   22989:2022).
While there are myriad standards and best practices to help organizations mitigate the risks
of traditional software or information-based systems, the risks posed by AI systems are in
many ways unique (See Appendix B). AI systems, for example, may be trained on data that
can change over time, sometimes significantly and unexpectedly, affecting system function-
ality and trustworthiness in ways that are hard to understand. AI systems and the contexts
in which they are deployed are frequently complex, making it difficult to detect and respond
to failures when they occur. AI systems are inherently socio-technical in nature, meaning
they are influenced by societal dynamics and human behavior. AI risks – and benefits –
can emerge from the interplay of technical aspects combined with societal factors related
to how a system is used, its interactions with other AI systems, who operates it, and the
social context in which it is deployed.
These risks make AI a uniquely challenging technology to deploy and utilize both for orga-
nizations and within society. Without proper controls, AI systems can amplify, perpetuate,
or exacerbate inequitable or undesirable outcomes for individuals and communities. With
proper controls, AI systems can mitigate and manage inequitable outcomes.
AI risk management is a key component of responsible development and use of AI sys-
tems. Responsible AI practices can help align the decisions about AI system design, de-
velopment, and uses with intended aim and values. Core concepts in responsible AI em-
phasize human centricity, social responsibility, and sustainability. AI risk management can
drive responsible uses and practices by prompting organizations and their internal teams
who design, develop, and deploy AI to think more critically about context and potential
or unexpected negative and positive impacts. Understanding and managing the risks of AI
systems will help to enhance trustworthiness, and in turn, cultivate public trust. 
Page 1

<!-- mira:item:item-1 -->
## AI 具有改变社会与多领域的潜力（潜力表述，非已然效果）
直接证据：原文称 “Artificial intelligence (AI) technologies have significant potential to transform society and people’s lives – from commerce and health to transportation and cybersecurity to the environment and our planet.” 并续称 “AI technologies can drive inclusive economic growth and support scientific advancements that improve the conditions of our world.” 定位：片段1（原文第1–40行，物理页6，页脚标 Page 1）。证据性质：材料直接陈述。限制：两句均为潜力/能力表述（“potential”“can”），列举领域为 commerce、health、transportation、cybersecurity、environment、planet；不能据此断言这些收益已经发生。
<!-- mira:end -->

<!-- mira:item:item-2 -->
## AI 也带来可负面影响个人到地球多层级对象的风险
直接证据：原文称 “AI technologies, however, also pose risks that can negatively impact individuals, groups, organizations, communities, society, the environment, and the planet.” 定位：片段1（原文第1–40行，物理页6，页脚标 Page 1）。证据性质：材料直接陈述。限制：原文用 “can negatively impact”，是可能性而非必然；受影响对象列举为 individuals、groups、organizations、communities、society、environment、planet；与上一条“potential/can”的收益并置，材料未裁决净效果。
<!-- mira:end -->

<!-- mira:item:item-3 -->
## AI 风险可沿时长、概率、范围、影响四个维度表征
直接证据：原文称 “Like risks for other types of technology, AI risks can emerge in a variety of ways and can be characterized as long- or short-term, high- or low-probability, systemic or localized, and high- or low-impact.” 定位：片段1（原文第1–40行，物理页6，页脚标 Page 1）。证据性质：材料直接陈述。限制：材料说 AI 风险“像其他技术风险一样”可用这些维度刻画，未据此声称这些维度为 AI 独有。
<!-- mira:end -->

<!-- mira:item:item-4 -->
## AI RMF 对“AI 系统”的定义、输出示例与自主性，及改写出处
直接证据：原文称 “The AI RMF refers to an AI system as an engineered or machine-based system that can, for a given set of objectives, generate outputs such as predictions, recommendations, or decisions influencing real or virtual environments. AI systems are designed to operate with varying levels of autonomy (Adapted from: OECD Recommendation on AI:2019; ISO/IEC 22989:2022).” 定位：片段1（原文第1–40行，物理页6，页脚标 Page 1）。证据性质：材料直接陈述；括注明确该定义改写自 OECD Recommendation on AI:2019 与 ISO/IEC 22989:2022。限制：输出仅示例（“such as”）；“varying levels of autonomy”未给出分级；引用标准年份以原文为准，未额外核对标准文本。
<!-- mira:end -->

<!-- mira:item:item-5 -->
## 材料称 AI 系统风险“在许多方面独特”并指向附录 B
直接证据：原文称 “While there are myriad standards and best practices to help organizations mitigate the risks of traditional software or information-based systems, the risks posed by AI systems are in many ways unique (See Appendix B).” 定位：片段1（原文第1–40行，物理页6，页脚标 Page 1）。证据性质：材料直接陈述。限制：限定为 “in many ways unique”，并非全称“完全独特”；具体独特性论证指向 Appendix B，本片段未包含附录内容，无法据此核实附录论据。
<!-- mira:end -->

<!-- mira:item:item-6 -->
## 训练数据可随时间显著且意外变化，进而难以理解地影响功能与可信性
直接证据：原文称 “AI systems, for example, may be trained on data that can change over time, sometimes significantly and unexpectedly, affecting system functionality and trustworthiness in ways that are hard to understand.” 定位：片段1（原文第1–40行，物理页6，页脚标 Page 1）。证据性质：材料直接陈述。限制：原文用 “may”“can”，并以 “for example” 引出，属可能性举例；未给出发生率或普遍程度。

items.markdown: 直接证据：原文称 “AI risk management is a key component of responsible development and use of AI systems.” 定位：片段1（原文第1–40行，物理页6，页脚标 Page 1）。证据性质：材料直接陈述。限制：“key component” 为地位判断，本片段未给出衡量“关键”的指标；不等同于说风险管理是充分条件或唯一组成。

items.title: 负责任 AI 实践可对齐设计开发使用决策与既定目标和价值，核心概念为人本、社会责任、可持续
items.markdown: 直接证据：原文称 “Responsible AI practices can help align the decisions about AI system design, development, and uses with intended aim and values. Core concepts in responsible AI emphasize human centricity, social responsibility, and sustainability.” 定位：片段1（原文第1–40行，物理页6，页脚标 Page 1）。证据性质：材料直接陈述。限制：对齐用 “can help”，非必然达成；“intended aim and values” 的具体内容随组织而定，本片段未界定；核心概念仅列三项，未展开定义。

items.title: 风险管理促使相关团队更批判思考语境与正负影响，并称理解管理风险有助增强可信性进而培育公众信任
items.markdown: 直接证据：原文称 “AI risk management can drive responsible uses and practices by prompting organizations and their internal teams who design, develop, and deploy AI to think more critically about context and potential or unexpected negative and positive impacts.” 以及 “Understanding and managing the risks of AI systems will help to enhance trustworthiness, and in turn, cultivate public trust.” 定位：片段1（原文第1–40行，物理页6，页脚标 Page 1）。证据性质：材料直接陈述。限制：机制限定为促使“design, develop, and deploy”的组织及内部团队更批判思考；思考对象含 “potential or unexpected” 的负正影响，须保留“潜在/意外”。后句 “will help to enhance ... cultivate” 是材料的方向性断言，本片段未提供已发生提升信任的证据，不能写成既成效果。
